x: Duffett, W. Lowden, a new member, who has been very successful in open handicaps recently, ran next, retaining the lead.

Cooper Clark, owing to indisposition, was unable to defend his titles, and the 880yds. championship was won in the fastest time yet recorded by Tom Scrimshaw. W. Lowden, a young runner of promise, set a very hot pace over the first quarter, after which Scrimshaw took the lead, followed by H.
Kench, who was running for Old Emanuel A.C., and is, of course, a members of our Club. Another member, W.
